result_text:
I changed `DataExporter.java` so `all_files.zip` is built from the configured aspect names instead of five fixed file names. It compiles (`mvn -q -o -pl reports compile`). I didn't run any tests or try a renamed config, so the renamed-aspect case is untested.

The export now takes the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects, in that order. It names each zip entry with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same helper that writes the loose `data/text/aspect_<name>.txt` files, and reads each file back under that name.

- **Default config:** the entries and their order are unchanged.
- **Renamed aspect:** with `buildAndDeployment`, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. The `git-history.zip` step comes right after in the same `try` block, so it is written again when a `git-history.txt` exists.
